summary.text: Donnie Ownby is an independent candidate who describes himself as a 69-year-old, semi-retired Christian conservative and Army veteran. He is running on congressional term limits, manufacturing and the working class, and education.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Army from 1974 to 1977, according to Ballotpedia.
Earned a high school diploma from Clinton High School and an associate degree from Roane State Community College, according to Ballotpedia.
Says his varied work experience includes military service, power line construction, transportation, X-ray and ultrasound technology, and running his own small trucking company.

Says he is 69, semi-retired, lives off the grid, and is married with a daughter, two living sons, and grandchildren; says he has followed politics since middle school but had not sought office until now.
